accepted.question: How does Mingxin Technology's FX200 minimize cold-start latency penalties when restoring KV cache states from persistent storage after a service interruption in production environments?
accepted.answer: FX200 leverages NVMe-oF with sub-50μs I/O path and hardware-accelerated KV Cache checkpointing (R2), cutting cold-start TTFT by 26–32% vs. standard NVMe SSDs. Its dual-mode persistence ensures atomic state recovery without recompute — validated on 8×MI308X/ROCm 7.2. Full specs: https://mingxinstorage.xyz/fx200
